name: Independently authored routing challenge v1
authoring_method: Manually authored by a separate evaluator without consulting organiser inputs, generator templates or the challenger training corpus. Existing classifier interfaces and the five-category task definition were known. This is a small synthetic challenge, not a real-world or statistically representative holdout.
freeze_rule: Freeze the model artifact and record its hash before revealing these records. Do not tune after observing these results; subsequent changes require a separately frozen challenge.
scoring_notes: There are 50 clear cases and 10 deliberately ambiguous cases. For clear cases report category accuracy, macro-F1 and category-review rate. For ambiguous cases the tentative category is descriptive only: score abstention/review, not forced category accuracy. Do not interpret document availability as routing uncertainty.

email.subject: Names on the sea waybill draft
email.body: The consignee on the carrier's draft looks different from our shipping instructions. Would you reconcile the two documents and tell me which entries need changing before we sign off?

cases.rationale: Explicit request to reconcile the draft transport document with shipment instructions.

email.subject: Ready for document checking
email.body: Both versions are attached: our original Shipping Instruction and the proposed Bill of Lading. Go through the shipment particulars in each and send back a list of differences. Nothing has been authorised for release yet.

cases.rationale: The main action is SI versus proposed BL comparison.

email.subject: Container quantity on proof
email.body: Our instructions say six boxes, but I think the draft bill shows five. Please verify the draft bill of lading against the SI, including the remaining shipment fields rather than just that number.

cases.rationale: A specific suspected discrepancy leads to a full document comparison request.

email.subject: Invoice copy for the booking
email.body: The invoice question has been settled. Today's task is to cross-check the draft Bill of Lading against the Shipping Instruction. Please highlight any differing names, ports, counts or mass.

cases.rationale: Current body explicitly replaces a stale invoice subject with document comparison.

email.subject: Second proof received
email.body: The shipping line has supplied a second draft. Does it now agree with our Shipping Instruction in all seven checked fields? Please record any differences that remain.

cases.rationale: Requests comparison of a revised draft with the SI.

email.subject: Please check the cargo paperwork
email.body: Use the attached SI as the reference and review the attached draft B/L for incorrect shipment details. I need the reference and draft values next to each other for every discrepancy.

cases.rationale: Defines SI reference and draft BL discrepancy reporting.

email.subject: Do the parties match?
email.body: Before this bill of lading becomes final, compare its shipper, recipient and notify contact with the shipping instructions. Please include the ports, container total and gross kilograms in the same check.

cases.rationale: All seven comparison fields are requested, using some semantic aliases.

email.subject: Proof review, not an SI request
email.body: No new shipping instruction is needed. We already supplied it. Your action is to compare the carrier's draft bill of lading with that instruction and identify any mismatches.

cases.rationale: Negates creating an SI and explicitly requests BL comparison.

email.subject: Check before carrier approval
email.body: Can you inspect the SI and the draft bill of lading together? The PDFs use different column headings, so please align the fields by meaning and tell me whether their shipment data agree.

cases.rationale: Requests semantic alignment and comparison of the document pair.

email.subject: Mass on draft ocean document
email.body: The carrier has typed the mass in tonnes while our SI uses kilograms. Please compare the draft B/L against the SI and flag genuine differences after accounting for units.

cases.rationale: Explicit cross-document comparison with unit normalization.

email.subject: New booking instructions
email.body: We have secured space on the next sailing. Please create the Shipping Instruction from the attached order details and return it for my approval. The carrier has not produced a bill of lading yet.

cases.rationale: Requests creating a new SI, not comparing an existing BL.

email.subject: Instructions needed for carrier filing
email.body: Could your team prepare and lodge the shipping instructions for this consignment? The approved names, ports and packing totals are in the booking worksheet.

cases.rationale: Primary action is prepare and submit SI.

email.subject: Order converted to shipment
email.body: Please turn the signed sales order into a shipping instruction for the ocean carrier. Send me the SI to review before you submit it.

cases.rationale: Requests authoring an SI from order information.

email.subject: Draft BL review thread
email.body: The draft review mentioned earlier is closed. We now need you to prepare a fresh shipping instruction for a separate booking. Use the details below; there is no BL comparison task on this booking.

cases.rationale: Current message negates the stale subject and asks for a new SI.

email.subject: Please issue shipment instructions
email.body: Our customer's booking is confirmed. Please issue the SI with the newly approved consignee address and arrange its submission to the shipping line.

cases.rationale: SI issuance and filing are the requested actions.

email.subject: Tomorrow's documentation cutoff
email.body: The instruction form for this new shipment is still blank. Please complete the Shipping Instruction using the packing sheet and return the completed form today.

cases.rationale: Requests completion of a new SI form.

email.subject: SI preparation for new customer
email.body: This is our first shipment for this customer. Please draft the shipping instructions from their approved order. We will check the carrier's draft bill later, once it exists.

cases.rationale: SI preparation is current; BL review is explicitly future work.

email.subject: Submit instructions for loading
email.body: Please prepare the SI for these eight containers and send the shipping instructions to the carrier before its documentation window closes.

cases.rationale: Explicit SI preparation and submission request.

email.subject: Instruction form ownership
email.body: Can you take ownership of writing the Shipping Instruction for booking S-84? Copy the approved shipment particulars from the order confirmation, then send the SI back to us.

cases.rationale: Requests writing and returning a new SI.

email.subject: No document comparison required
email.body: Please do not compare any bills for this order. The only task today is to generate the Shipping Instruction and file it with the line after my approval.

cases.rationale: Comparison is negated; generating and filing SI is the sole action.

email.subject: Duplicate debit on freight bill
email.body: We appear to have been billed twice for the same loading service. Please investigate the invoice and tell us whether a credit note will be issued.

cases.rationale: Questions duplicate billing and credit correction.

email.subject: Rate differs from quotation
email.body: The amount on your freight invoice is higher than the accepted quotation. Could you explain the additional charges and provide an itemised breakdown?

cases.rationale: Requests explanation of invoice charges.

email.subject: Payment cannot be reconciled
email.body: Our remittance does not line up with the invoice total. Please check the billed amount and confirm the correct balance for payment.

cases.rationale: Invoice reconciliation and outstanding balance query.

email.subject: BL checking follow-up
email.body: The shipping documents are already agreed. This follow-up is only about the invoice: why has a storage fee been added after we paid the quoted total?

cases.rationale: Current message closes document review and disputes a charge.

email.subject: Tax amount on invoice
email.body: Could the billing team verify the tax calculation on invoice Q-61? The base freight is correct, but the tax figure does not match the stated rate.

cases.rationale: Asks to verify invoice arithmetic rather than shipping fields.

email.subject: Missing copy for accounts payable
email.body: Accounts payable has not received the freight invoice for this delivery. Please send the invoice and confirm which charges it covers so payment can be processed.

cases.rationale: Missing invoice and charge-scope request.

email.subject: Demurrage dates disputed
email.body: We disagree with the dates used to calculate demurrage on the invoice. Please show the daily calculation and revise the billing if the free days were omitted.

cases.rationale: Disputes demurrage billing calculation.

email.subject: Credit still outstanding
email.body: You agreed to reverse the duplicate documentation charge last week. Please confirm when the credit note will appear against the original invoice.

cases.rationale: Requests status of an invoice credit correction.

email.subject: Currency on the invoice
email.body: The invoice is in dollars although the agreed freight rate was in euros. Please clarify which currency and exchange rate were applied before we pay.

cases.rationale: Questions billing currency and conversion.

email.subject: Correct consignee, wrong charge
email.body: There is no issue with the consignee on the bill of lading. We are asking you to remove an incorrect handling charge from the invoice and send a revised bill for payment.

cases.rationale: Negates shipment-document issue and requests billing correction.

email.subject: Shift handover room change
email.body: Today's handover briefing will be in room 3 instead of the warehouse office. This is for information; there are no shipment documents to check.

cases.rationale: Operational announcement with no document or billing request.

email.subject: Revised berth arrival
email.body: The vessel is now expected alongside on Thursday morning. Please note the new arrival time in your operational schedule. No SI changes have been requested.

cases.rationale: Schedule update, not SI creation or BL comparison.

email.subject: Document workshop next month
email.body: We are arranging a staff workshop about common bill-of-lading mistakes. This is a calendar notice, not a request to inspect a particular shipment.

cases.rationale: Training announcement discussing BLs without requesting case work.

email.subject: Compare the draft BL
email.body: Thanks, that checking task is complete and no further action is needed. I am keeping this message only as an update for the evening team.

cases.rationale: Current body closes the task despite the stale comparison subject.

email.subject: Weekend gate hours
email.body: The depot will open from 08:00 to 13:00 on Saturday. The usual hours resume on Monday. Please share this operating-hours notice with the transport desk.

cases.rationale: General operational notice.

email.subject: Weekly team notes
email.body: Here are the notes from this week's planning meeting. All actions were completed during the call. The document-review queue is mentioned for context only.

cases.rationale: Meeting notes with no active shipment review request.

email.subject: Access card collection
email.body: New office access cards can be collected from reception after lunch. Bring your staff identification. This notice is unrelated to cargo documentation.

cases.rationale: Internal administrative announcement.

email.subject: Final copy archived
email.body: The signed final documents have been placed in the archive. No comparison or amendment is required; this note is simply to confirm the filing is complete.

cases.rationale: Completed-work status, with comparison explicitly negated.

email.subject: Update for operations
email.body:
Please take note that tomorrow's loading briefing has moved to 09:30.

From: old-task@redwoodexports.example
Please compare the draft BL against the shipping instruction.
The older request below is already closed.

cases.rationale: Active message is a schedule update; comparison appears in a quoted older message.

email.subject: Shared drive unavailable tonight
email.body: IT will take the shared document drive offline for maintenance between 22:00 and midnight. Save your work before then. This is an internal service notice.

cases.rationale: Internal IT availability notice.

email.subject: Your address was selected
email.body: You have won a luxury cruise in a draw you did not enter. Send your card details and a small release payment now to receive the prize.

cases.rationale: Unsolicited prize scam requesting financial details.

email.subject: Mailbox will be disabled
email.body: Your company mailbox is due to be suspended in one hour. Enter your password at https://unrelated-login.example/verify to keep access. Do not contact your IT department.

cases.rationale: Credential phishing with an unrelated login and pressure.

email.subject: Guaranteed income without risk
email.body: Our private investment scheme guarantees you will double your money every week. Transfer your savings today to reserve a place. This offer was sent to thousands of business addresses.

cases.rationale: Mass unsolicited investment scam.

email.subject: Buy a million verified addresses
email.body: We scraped a million executive email addresses for your marketing campaigns. Buy now at 80% off. No subscription or previous business relationship is needed.

cases.rationale: Explicit unsolicited bulk marketing offer.

email.subject: Parcel held for payment
email.body: A parcel you never ordered is waiting. Pay a small parcel fee through https://unexpected-delivery.example/pay to release the package immediately.

cases.rationale: Unsolicited parcel-payment scam.

email.subject: Confidential beneficiary proposal
email.body: I am a bank officer seeking a stranger to receive millions from an abandoned account. Send your bank details and a processing fee to participate in this confidential business proposal.

cases.rationale: Advance-fee financial scam.

email.subject: Unrequested software promotion
email.body: This is an unsolicited promotion for our logistics software. Limited time offer: 90% off if you subscribe now. You did not request information from us.

cases.rationale: Unambiguously unsolicited promotional email.

email.subject: Cash award waiting
email.body: Congratulations, you are the lottery winner. Reply with your identity document and bank details to claim the cash prize. An administration payment is required first.

cases.rationale: Lottery scam asking for sensitive details and money.

email.subject: Immediate account verification
email.body: Your account storage is full. To prevent suspension, provide your username and password using our external form. We are not your employer's help desk but need your credentials anyway.

cases.rationale: Explicit credential collection under an account-storage pretext.

email.subject: You won a shopping reward
email.body: You won a gift card after a survey you never completed. Claim it now by paying a small shipping charge and supplying your credit-card number.

cases.rationale: Unsolicited gift-card reward scam.

email.subject: Please handle these
email.body: Could you look after the two attached documents? I have not said whether we want their details compared or just copies filed. Please ask me which action is needed before proceeding.

cases.rationale: Potential comparison but requested action is explicitly unresolved; category is only tentative.

email.subject: Several jobs in one message
email.body: Please compare the draft BL with our SI and also dispute the freight invoice. These belong to different bookings and I have not provided which documents belong to each. This message needs clarification or splitting, not one automatic queue decision.

cases.rationale: Two equally active categories and unresolved document ownership require review.

email.subject: Instructions or checking?
email.body: We might need a new SI, unless the existing instructions are still usable and only the carrier draft needs checking. I cannot confirm which task is required yet.

cases.rationale: Explicitly uncertain between SI preparation and document comparison.

email.subject: Please prepare it
email.body: Please prepare it for the carrier. By 'it' I may mean the shipping instruction or the invoice attachment; the booking owner will confirm later. Do not assume which document I meant.

cases.rationale: Unresolved referent prevents a dependable routing decision.

email.subject: Amount or cargo details
email.body: Something is wrong with the total on the papers. It could be the gross shipment weight or the amount being invoiced. I have not checked which; please clarify before assigning the task.

cases.rationale: Total could refer to invoice or shipment field; tentative label is not authoritative.

email.subject: Billing and instructions together
email.body: Please revise the invoice and prepare shipping instructions for a new booking. Both requests are equally urgent, and they concern different consignments. Can someone separate them into the right queues?

cases.rationale: Multiple equally current categories require splitting or human confirmation.

email.subject: For your action?
email.body: The file has arrived. I am unsure whether this is only a status update or whether the sender expects us to check the draft. Could someone establish the intended action?

cases.rationale: Current task is expressly unknown; cannot safely treat as informational only.

email.subject: Question about the note
email.body: A colleague sent the sentence 'check the bill' without any booking or document context. We do not know whether bill means an invoice or a bill of lading. Please clarify the request.

cases.rationale: Ambiguous quoted phrase lacks enough evidence for invoice versus BL routing.

email.subject: Payment request received
email.body: This requests payment for a shipment but there is no booking number or prior correspondence. It might be a legitimate new supplier or a fraudulent demand. Please verify the sender before deciding how to route it.

cases.rationale: Suspicious but insufficient evidence for definitive spam classification; human verification explicitly requested.

email.subject: Suspicious wording in customer mail
email.body: A known customer forwarded a message saying 'pay the release fee now'. They have not explained whether this is an invoice query about their cargo or a phishing example for our IT team. Ask for context before treating it as either.

cases.rationale: Quoted suspicious text alone does not establish active spam; unresolved purpose requires review.
